title: Bounded generic prompt validation: front reference-only controls and left-profile reference/depth pairs
submit_gate: Do not submit until every row in ../plan.json prompt-cause matrix has a terminal completed receipt with verified output hash. Then recheck task controller, GPU occupancy, queue and refreshed resources, and acquire/retain the active task lease.

prompts.front_B_exact: Create one finished full-body, strict straight-on frontal view of the same character. Keep a natural upright stance, both arms slightly away from the torso, both feet fully visible, and the complete figure centered. Preserve the character design and rendering style. Use a warm off-white studio background, soft even lighting, and a subtle floor shadow. No labels or text.
prompts.left_profile_generic: Create one finished full-body, strict left-facing side profile view of the same character. Keep a natural upright stance, both arms slightly away from the torso, both feet fully visible, and the complete figure centered. Preserve the character design and rendering style. Use a warm off-white studio background, soft even lighting, and a subtle floor shadow. No labels or text.

front_comparison.depth_condition: Existing prompt-cause B output at same seed, reference, depth map, and frozen settings; no extra depth-conditioned render in this phase.
front_comparison.appearance_only_pair: New no-ControlNet output using exactly B prompt and same seed.
front_comparison.scope: Test whether the generic target-only prompt retains stronger visible color/material when depth control is absent; this does not attribute appearance shifts to grayscale wording.

side_comparison.reference_plus_depth: Same image, side prompt, seed and sampler, with the matching left-side depth map connected only to ControlNet image input at strength 0.5 from 0 to 1.
side_comparison.scope: Bounded transfer check for one non-front view; not cross-character stability and not semantic equipment validation.

graph_contract.appearance: TextEncodeQwenImageEditPlus.image1 receives appearance image only; image2 is omitted.
graph_contract.structure: For depth rows only, QwenImageDiffsynthControlnet.image receives matching view depth. For appearance-only rows, omit ModelPatchLoader, depth LoadImage, and ControlNet node entirely.

limits: Front appearance-only rows pair with already completed B depth outputs; confirm those receipts/hashes before running.
Six outputs cover one character, one front setup and one left-profile setup only.
Equipment semantics and bow issues are out of scope.
